basic_details.job_title: Mizoram Law and Judicial Department Deputy Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Law and Judicial Department, Government of Mizoram, proposes to fill 1 (one) Deputy Secretary post (Group A, Gazetted) on deputation, initially for three years. Eligible officers must submit the prescribed application form to the Under Secretary, Law and Judicial Department, through proper channel with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate, latest by 4 December 2026. The vacancy circular is dated 20 November 2026.

qualification.details: Qualification: members of the Judicial Service, IAS/IPS or any State service cadre of appropriate grade, having at least a Bachelor's Degree in Law from a recognized University. Age limit: not more than 56 years of age as on the last date for submission of the application. Mode of filling: deputation basis, initially for a period of three (3) years. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. | Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Mizoram Law and Judicial Department Deputy Secretary at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee or a selection process.

content_sections.heading: About Mizoram Law and Judicial Department
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Law and Judicial Department of the Government of Mizoram from the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO, Khatla, Aizawl. It is circulated to all administrative departments and heads of departments of the Government of Mizoram and to the Registrar, Gauhati High Court, Aizawl Bench.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application in the prescribed form enclosed with the circular to the Under Secretary, Law and Judicial Department, Government of Mizoram. It must go through proper channel, together with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate, latest by 4 December 2026. The notice does not print a separate postal address with a PIN code, an envelope superscription or a postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: members of the Judicial Service, IAS/IPS or any State service cadre of appropriate grade, having at least a Bachelor's Degree in Law from a recognized University. Age limit: not more than 56 years of age as on the last date for submission of the application. Mode of filling: deputation basis, initially for a period of three (3) years. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed form (enclosed with the vacancy circular). Vigilance Clearance Certificate.

faq.question: Q1. How many Deputy Secretary posts are vacant in the Mizoram Law and Judicial Department?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 (one) vacant post of Deputy Secretary, classified as Group A (Gazetted).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Mizoram Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted latest by 4 December 2026, to the Under Secretary, Law and Judicial Department.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: Members of the Judicial Service, IAS/IPS or any State service cadre of appropriate grade, having at least a Bachelor's Degree in Law from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be more than 56 years of age as on the last date for submission of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the Deputy Secretary post?
faq.answer: The pay is Level-12 in the Pay Matrix (₹78,800-₹1,75,200/-).

faq.question: Q6. Is the Deputy Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: The post is to be filled on deputation basis, initially for a period of three (3) years.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Mizoram Deputy Secretary vacancy?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed form to the Under Secretary, Law and Judicial Department, through proper channel along with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate, latest by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Can I withdraw my candidature after applying?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
